format: Vanilla 26.3 decoration with structures. areas: one per line, one per structure id (its first start in structure_starts): dimension, seed, min_y, height, structure, start [chunk x, z], x, z (centre chunk: of the chunks intersecting a piece of the start, the one whose 3x3 area intersects the most distinct piece types; ties: nearest to the start chunk, then smaller z, then smaller x). On fresh chunks: createStructures (all chunks within 10 of the centre), createReferences (within 2), biomes, terrain with the Beardifier (within 2, as structure_terrain), then applyBiomeDecoration with generateStructures on for the 3x3 chunks around the centre in row-major order (z outer), each with a WorldGenRegion of the features step (writes within 1 chunk, starts read within 8). chunks: the 5x5 chunks around the centre (z outer) in the format of feature.json decorations (sections, heightmaps WORLD_SURFACE/OCEAN_FLOOR/MOTION_BLOCKING/MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES, post_processing, block_ticks, fluid_ticks) with block_entities [x, y, z, type id, nbt] sorted by y, z, x where nbt is BlockEntity.saveWithoutMetadata as JSON (keys sorted; chests carry LootTable and LootTableSeed) or null for a block entity that was never created (pending DUMMY tag, id then 'DUMMY'). entities: [index of the decorated chunk (0-8, row-major), entity type id, x, y, z] in the order addFreshEntity got them.
